0022600123.text: The Indiana Pacers (2-1, 2-0 on the road, 2nd in the Central and 1 game back, 5th in the East) visit the Milwaukee Bucks (0-3 on a three-game losing streak, 5th in the Central and 3 games back, 13th in the East) in Indiana's fourth game of the season. Indiana is missing Andrew Nembhard (back soreness), Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), and T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Pacers lost the 2025-26 season series 0-4, and their most recent meeting was a 134-123 loss in Milwaukee on March 15, 2026.
